newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada farmers group objects to UGG bid.
newsitem.headline: Canada farmers group objects to UGG bid.

text.p: The Western Canadian Wheat Growers Association said on Monday it would file an objection with Canada's Competition Bureau over Alberta and Manitoba wheat pools' hostile takeover bid for United Grain Growers Ltd.

"We believe the proposed takeover would result in a substantial lessening of competition in the grain handling, marketing and farm supply retailing business," association president Larry Maguire said in a statement.
"In many parts of western Canada it will create a virtual monopoly," he said.
Maguire said the takeover would place barriers on new competitors entering the market because the pools have "consistently opposed deregulation."
The WCWGA said it planned to submit a formal presentation to the Competition Bureau, Canada's main regulatory authority on competition issues, later this week.
The group suggested the bureau examine the impact of the proposed deal on local competition, grade and weight gains and retail farm supplies.
